# Metrics dashboard — Style Prompt

> A dark analytics screen tells a turnaround. A warning card drops in and one big metric counts down in red; the frame pushes sideways to a grid of cards; then a live dashboard counts every number up while a chart line draws itself to a glowing dot. The ending wipes down over everything: the offer in heavy type and a contact pill that breathes. Numbers are the heroes; cards are the stage.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **numbers changing on cards**. Each beat is one screen of a dashboard: a single metric, a grid of four cards, or a stack of a big card, two small cards and a chart. The story is told by the direction the numbers move: down in a fixed red, then up in the rising colour, with a line that climbs to a dot. Between screens the whole frame pushes sideways like swiping to the next panel; the ending is a solid panel that wipes down from the top.

Not a real app recording (no cursors, menus, tabs, scrollbars or invented interface chrome), not an infographic (no pie charts, icons or legends; one line chart at most), not a spreadsheet (never more than three numbers on screen at once), not a neon cyber look (no grids of glowing lines, no scanlines, no glitch).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **The ground**: the background colour, flat, with one 1300 px radial glow of the main colour (22 % at the centre, transparent by 60 %) drawn as a gradient, never a filter. It breathes slowly for the whole film.
- **Cards**: the second surface, corners 30-32 px, padding 36-40 px, and a 2 px inset hairline of the text colour at 5 % (`box-shadow: inset`, static) so a card still separates from a light brand's ground.
- **The alert card**: 150 px tall, a 76 px rounded red square as its icon, the label in body bold, the value pushed to the right in the headline face, red.
- **The big metric**: a single number with a one-decimal unit (`1.2x`), 300 px, centred under a spaced label.
- **The chart card**: 420 px tall, one SVG path (10 px stroke, round caps and joins) in the main colour, drawn with `stroke-dashoffset`, ending in a 16 px dot in the accent. The SVG stretches to the card (`preserveAspectRatio="none"`), so keep the dot small.
- **The pill**: the call to action as a rounded pill (radius 90 px) in the main colour.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the ground and the ending panel; `--latar-2`: every card.
- `--utama`: the glow, the chart line, the key word of a headline ("diem?", "1 tim.", "GRATIS") and the pill. `--teks-di-utama`: the pill's text.
- `--teks`: card titles, questions and headlines; `--teks-redup`: spaced labels, card sub-labels and the contact line.
- `--aksen`: the chart's end dot, and the rising numbers when it reads on the cards.
- `--naik` (look token): the colour of numbers going up. It starts as `var(--aksen)`; the script checks it against `--latar-2` and falls back to `--utama`, then `--teks`, when it is under 3:1, so a pale accent on a light brand never vanishes.
- `--bahaya` (look token, fixed `#ff5b5b`): only for what is going wrong: the falling metric, the alert icon and its value. It never follows the brand and never marks anything good.
- `--garis-kartu` (look token): the cards' hairline, the text colour at 5 %.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the numbers and the closing offer: a heavy, wide grotesque (Archivo Black by default; Poppins 800 or Space Grotesk 700 hold; a condensed face like Bebas Neue turns it into a tall ticker). It is set at weight 800 with `font-synthesis: none`, so a brand family uses its heaviest face and a single-weight display face is never faux-bolded.
- `--font-isi` carries questions, headings, card titles and labels: Space Grotesk 500 and 700, sentence case.
- Sizes at 1080 wide: the big metric 300 px, the dashboard metric 230 px, small-card values 64 px, the ending offer 150 px at line-height 0.98; the question 104 px and the grid headline 96 px (body bold, line-height 1.02-1.05); card titles 50 px; the alert label 44 px; labels 40-46 px with 6-12 px letter-spacing in caps; contact 44 px; the pill 56 px. Nothing under 40 px.
- Card titles stay within about 12 characters at 50 px (a card's text box is 363 px wide).

## 5. Motion quality

- **Alert**: drops from `y: -60` with a fade, 0.5 s `back.out(1.6)`.
- **Metric pop**: `scale: 0.7 → 1` with a fade, 0.5 s `expo.out`, then counts down (1.2 → 0.8) over 1.2 s `power2.inOut`, written by `onUpdate` with one decimal.
- **Masked question**: two lines rise from `yPercent: 110` through `overflow: hidden` boxes, 0.6 s `expo.out`, stagger 0.14 s; it holds about 1.6 s.
- **Push**: the outgoing scene goes to `xPercent: -100` while the next comes from `xPercent: 100`, both 0.6 s `power3.inOut`, at the same moment.
- **Card rise**: the headline rises 60 px (0.6 s `expo.out`), then each card from `y: 70`, `scale: 0.94` and a fade, 0.5 s `back.out(1.5)`, stagger 0.12 s.
- **Dashboard count-up**: the main metric 1.2 → 4.6 over 1.6 s `power3.out`, the small values over 1.4-1.6 s `power3.out`, starting 0.2 s apart; the line draws over 1.6 s `power2.out` from 0.3 s after the first count; the dot pops `scale: 0 → 1` in 0.4 s `back.out(2.4)` as the line lands.
- **Ending**: the panel wipes `clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0) → inset(0)` over 0.7 s `expo.inOut`; its three lines rise 70 px with a fade, 0.55 s `power3.out`, stagger 0.14 s; the pill breathes to 1.05 (0.45 s `sine.inOut`, yoyo, 4 halves); everything holds, then the film fades out in the last 0.5 s.
- **Background**: the glow scales 0.9 → 1.15 over the full 15 s, `sine.inOut`.
- Scenes last 3-4 s: 0-3.8 s, 3.8-7 s, 7-11 s, then the ending from 11 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

The frame is a fixed screen; scenes change like panels of an app.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Sideways push | next panel, same system | problem to solution, one topic to the next |
| Count down in red | something is leaking | a balance hitting zero, falling views, a low score |
| Count up in the rising colour | it is working | revenue, followers, pass rate, orders |
| Line drawing to a dot | progress over time | a monthly trend, a learning curve, a story's arc |
| Cards rising into a grid | coverage, a set of options | services, content series, course modules, characters |
| Panel wiping down | the decision | the offer, the sign-up, the next episode |

## 7. Native moves

- **Red drop.** An alert card falls in and one huge metric counts down in red, then a two-line question rises. *Fits content like:* "Saldo iklan habis" for an ad agency; "Views turun 40%" opening a creator's honest monthly recap; "Nilai rata-rata 58" for a tutoring class; "Tabungan Rp0" opening a short story about the end of the month.
- **Card grid.** A headline with its key word in the main colour, then four cards rise one by one. *Fits content like:* the platforms an agency handles; a creator's four content series; the four modules of an online class; four suspects in a mystery.
- **Live dashboard.** A big card, two small cards and a chart, all counting up at once. *Fits content like:* campaign results; a channel's year in numbers; a school's pass rate; a bakery's monthly orders.
- **Line to a dot.** One path draws itself and lands on a popping dot. *Fits content like:* revenue climbing; subscriber growth; a student's scores over a term; a character's mood over a week.
- **Wipe-down offer.** A solid panel wipes over the dashboard with the offer, a breathing pill and the contact. *Fits content like:* "Audit akun iklan gratis"; "Gabung membership"; "Daftar kelas data"; "Baca bab berikutnya".

## 8. Pitfalls

- Three numbers on screen is the limit; a fourth turns the beat into a spreadsheet nobody reads on a phone.
- Counting numbers must stop at least 1.2 s before the next push, or the final value is never read.
- Keep one format per number (`4.6x`, `Rp32.000`, `Rp48,9 jt`) so the count does not change shape halfway; round with `toFixed` or `toLocaleString("id-ID")`.
- Red is fixed and means "wrong". With a red brand, the drop and the brand share a hue: keep the drop in `--bahaya` and let the rise use `--aksen` or `--teks`, never red for good news.
- Numbers written straight in `--aksen` can vanish on a light brand; use `--naik` (or check 3:1 against `--latar-2` yourself).
- On a light brand the second surface comes out close to the ground: keep the hairline, and never drop the cards' separation to a shadow that animates.
- No real platform names or logos on the cards: describe the channel ("Media sosial", "Pencarian").
- The stretched SVG makes circles oval: keep dots small, or draw them as HTML on top.
- Do not animate `box-shadow` or blur the glow; scale the gradient element instead.

# Metrics dashboard: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.6, long 3.

## hook

- en: an alert card drops in, the metric counts down in red, a two-line question rises
- id: kartu peringatan jatuh, metrik turun merah, pertanyaan dua baris naik

## problem

- en: a red line falls as it draws itself across a chart card
- id: garis merah turun sambil tergambar di kartu grafik

## fact

- en: a headline, then cards rise into a 2×2 grid one by one
- id: judul, lalu kartu naik satu per satu ke grid 2×2

## step

- en: one card per step lights up in the main colour
- id: satu kartu menyala warna utama tiap langkah

## compare

- en: before and after lines on one chart card
- id: garis sebelum dan sesudah di satu kartu grafik

## number

- en: dashboard cards: the metrics count up in the rising colour, the chart line draws
- id: kartu dasbor: metrik dihitung naik, garis grafik tergambar

## proof

- en: the result number counts up on a card, its source under it
- id: angka hasil dihitung naik di kartu, sumbernya di bawah

## offer

- en: the offer in big type over the dimmed dashboard
- id: penawaran huruf besar di atas dasbor yang diredupkan

## cta

- en: a panel wipes down: the offer, a breathing contact pill, held 2 s
- id: panel menyapu turun: penawaran, pill kontak berdenyut, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the rising line finishes and its end dot pops, held 2 s
- id: garis naik selesai dan titik ujungnya muncul, diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Dasbor metrik</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Milik gaya ini: --bahaya (merah metrik jatuh),
         --naik (angka yang naik: aksen yang terbaca di latar), --garis-kartu (tepi tipis kartu). */
      :root {
        --latar: #07090c; --latar-2: #12161c; --utama: #2ab8f8; --aksen: #c6f432;
        --teks: #f3f6f9; --teks-redup: #8a94a3; --teks-di-utama: #07090c;
        --teks-di-aksen: #14161a; --utama-di-latar: #2ab8f8; --aksen-di-latar: #c6f432;
        --font-judul: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --bahaya: #ff5b5b;
        --naik: var(--aksen-di-latar);
        --garis-kartu: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 5%, transparent);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .glow { position: absolute; width: 1300px; height: 1300px; left: -110px; top: 300px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 22%, transparent), transparent 60%); }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      /* Angka besar dan penutup: huruf judul pada ketebalan terberat yang ada, tanpa tebal palsu. */
      .alert em, .roas, .big, .end .judul { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-synthesis: none; }
      /* Kartu: permukaan kedua dengan garis tipis, supaya tetap terlihat di latar brand yang terang. */
      .alert, .pf, .card { background: var(--latar-2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--garis-kartu); }
      .alert { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 300px; height: 150px; border-radius: 30px;
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; padding: 0 40px; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; }
      .alert i { width: 76px; height: 76px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--bahaya); }
      .alert em { margin-left: auto; font-style: normal; color: var(--bahaya); }
      .roas-label { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 560px; text-align: center; font-size: 46px; letter-spacing: 12px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .roas { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 620px; text-align: center; font-size: 300px; line-height: 1; }
      .roas.turun { color: var(--bahaya); }
      .tanya { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 1180px; text-align: center; font-size: 104px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; }
      .tanya .line { display: block; overflow: hidden; }
      .tanya .line span { display: block; }
      .tanya b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .platforms { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 380px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 30px; }
      .platforms h2 { grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 96px; line-height: 1.02; margin-bottom: 20px; }
      .platforms h2 b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .pf { height: 230px; border-radius: 32px; padding: 36px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; }
      .pf b { font-size: 50px; }
      .pf span { font-size: 40px; color: var(--teks-redup); margin-top: 6px; }
      .dash { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 300px; }
      .dash h3 { font-size: 46px; margin-bottom: 30px; }
      .card { border-radius: 32px; padding: 40px; }
      .card small { font-size: 40px; letter-spacing: 6px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .big { font-size: 230px; line-height: 1; color: var(--naik); margin-top: 10px; }
      .pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 30px; margin-top: 30px; }
      .pair b { display: block; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 64px; color: var(--naik); }
      .chart { margin-top: 30px; height: 420px; }
      .chart svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      .chart .garis { fill: none; stroke: var(--utama); }
      .chart .titik { fill: var(--aksen); }
      .end { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--latar); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        text-align: center; padding: 0 90px; }
      .end .judul { font-size: 150px; line-height: 0.98; }
      .end .judul b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); font-weight: inherit; }
      .end .wa { margin-top: 70px; padding: 30px 70px; border-radius: 90px; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; }
      .end .nama { margin-top: 40px; font-size: 44px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="glow" id="glow"></div>

      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="alert" id="alert"><i></i>Saldo iklan habis<em>Rp0</em></div>
        <div class="roas-label">ROAS</div>
        <div class="roas turun" id="roas1">1.2x</div>
        <div class="tanya" id="tanya">
          <span class="line"><span>Iklan jalan…</span></span>
          <span class="line"><span>omzet kok <b>diem?</b></span></span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="fact">
        <div class="platforms">
          <h2>Semua platform,<br /><b>1 tim.</b></h2>
          <div class="pf"><b>Media sosial</b><span>Feed & story</span></div>
          <div class="pf"><b>Pencarian</b><span>Kata kunci</span></div>
          <div class="pf"><b>Video pendek</b><span>Live & afiliasi</span></div>
          <div class="pf"><b>Marketplace</b><span>Toko & voucher</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="number">
        <div class="dash">
          <h3>Dasbor real-time</h3>
          <div class="card"><small>ROAS</small><div class="big" id="roas2">1.2x</div></div>
          <div class="pair">
            <div class="card"><small>CPA</small><b id="cpa">Rp0</b></div>
            <div class="card"><small>OMZET</small><b id="omzet">Rp0</b></div>
          </div>
          <div class="card chart">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 800 300" preserveAspectRatio="none">
              <path id="line" class="garis" d="M10 260 L130 240 L250 250 L370 190 L490 170 L610 110 L730 40" stroke-width="10"
                stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="900" stroke-dashoffset="0" />
              <circle id="titik" class="titik" cx="730" cy="40" r="16" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="end" id="end" data-role="cta">
        <div class="judul">AUDIT AKUN IKLAN <b>GRATIS</b></div>
        <div class="wa">Chat Chat sekarang</div>
        <div class="nama">Chat 0812-3456-7890 · Iklanku</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const rp = (n) => "Rp" + Math.round(n).toLocaleString("id-ID");
      const x = (n) => n.toFixed(1) + "x";

      tl.fromTo("#glow", { scale: 0.9 }, { scale: 1.15, duration: 15, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0);

      // Adegan 1 (0–4 detik), hook: peringatan jatuh, ROAS turun merah, pertanyaan naik dari mask.
      const r1 = { v: 1.2 };
      const roas1 = document.getElementById("roas1");
      tl.from("#alert", { y: -60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.6)" }, 0.2)
        .from("#roas1", { scale: 0.7, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "expo.out" }, 0.5)
        .to(r1, { v: 0.8, duration: 1.2, ease: "power2.inOut", onUpdate: () => { roas1.textContent = x(r1.v); } }, 0.8)
        .from("#tanya .line span", { yPercent: 110, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.14 }, 1.6)
        .to("#s1", { xPercent: -100, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 3.8);

      // Adegan 2 (4–7 detik), fact: judul, lalu kartu naik satu per satu ke grid 2×2.
      tl.from("#s2", { xPercent: 100, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 3.8)
        .from(".platforms h2", { y: 60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 4.3)
        .from(".pf", { y: 70, opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.5)", stagger: 0.12 }, 4.6)
        .to("#s2", { xPercent: -100, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 7.0);

      // Adegan 3 (7–11 detik), number: angka dasbor dihitung naik, garis grafik tergambar.
      const r2 = { v: 1.2 }, cpa = { v: 0 }, omz = { v: 0 };
      const roas2 = document.getElementById("roas2"), cpaEl = document.getElementById("cpa"), omzEl = document.getElementById("omzet");
      tl.from("#s3", { xPercent: 100, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 7.0)
        .to(r2, { v: 4.6, duration: 1.6, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { roas2.textContent = x(r2.v); } }, 7.5)
        .to(cpa, { v: 32000, duration: 1.4, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { cpaEl.textContent = rp(cpa.v); } }, 7.7)
        .to(omz, { v: 48900000, duration: 1.6, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { omzEl.textContent = "Rp" + (omz.v / 1e6).toLocaleString("id-ID", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) + " jt"; } }, 7.7)
        .fromTo("#line", { attr: { "stroke-dashoffset": 900 } }, { attr: { "stroke-dashoffset": 0 }, duration: 1.6, ease: "power2.out" }, 7.8)
        .from("#titik", { scale: 0, transformOrigin: "50% 50%", duration: 0.4, ease: "back.out(2.4)" }, 9.3);

      // Penutup (11–15 detik), cta: panel menyapu turun, ajakan diam lebih dari 2 detik.
      tl.fromTo("#end", { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 100% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 11.0)
        .from("#end > *", { y: 70, opacity: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.14 }, 11.4)
        .to(".end .wa", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.45, yoyo: true, repeat: 3, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 12.3)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

        font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .glow { position: absolute; width: 1300px; height: 1300px; left: 620px; top: -160px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 22%, transparent), transparent 60%); }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      /* Angka besar dan penutup: huruf judul pada ketebalan terberat yang ada, tanpa tebal palsu. */
      .alert em, .roas, .big, .end .judul { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-synthesis: none; }
      /* Kartu: permukaan kedua dengan garis tipis, supaya tetap terlihat di latar brand yang terang. */
      .alert, .pf, .card { background: var(--latar-2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--garis-kartu); }
      /* Lebar: peringatan dan pertanyaan di kiri, ROAS merah besar di kanan. */
      .alert { position: absolute; left: 110px; width: 860px; top: 320px; height: 150px; border-radius: 30px;
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; padding: 0 40px; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; }
      .alert i { width: 76px; height: 76px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--bahaya); }
      .alert em { margin-left: auto; font-style: normal; color: var(--bahaya); }
      .roas-label { position: absolute; left: 1010px; right: 110px; top: 370px; text-align: center; font-size: 46px; letter-spacing: 12px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .roas { position: absolute; left: 1010px; right: 110px; top: 440px; text-align: center; font-size: 300px; line-height: 1; }
      .roas.turun { color: var(--bahaya); }
      .tanya { position: absolute; left: 110px; width: 860px; top: 590px; text-align: left; font-size: 104px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; }
      .tanya .line { display: block; overflow: hidden; }
      .tanya .line span { display: block; }
      .tanya b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      /* Lebar: judul di kolom kiri, grid kartu 2×2 di kanan. */
      .platforms { position: absolute; left: 110px; right: 110px; top: 280px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 700px 1fr 1fr; gap: 30px; }
      .platforms h2 { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / 3; align-self: center; font-size: 104px; line-height: 1.02; }
      .platforms h2 b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .pf { height: 230px; border-radius: 32px; padding: 36px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; }
      .pf b { font-size: 50px; }
      .pf span { font-size: 40px; color: var(--teks-redup); margin-top: 6px; }
      /* Lebar: angka di kolom kiri, grafik setinggi kolom di kanan. */
      .dash { position: absolute; left: 110px; right: 110px; top: 150px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; column-gap: 40px; }
      .dash h3 { grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 46px; margin-bottom: 30px; }
      .dash > .card:not(.chart) { grid-column: 1; }
      .dash .pair { grid-column: 1; }
      .card { border-radius: 32px; padding: 40px; }
      .card small { font-size: 40px; letter-spacing: 6px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .big { font-size: 230px; line-height: 1; color: var(--naik); margin-top: 10px; }
      .pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 30px; margin-top: 30px; }
      .pair b { display: block; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 64px; color: var(--naik); }
      .chart { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2 / 4; height: auto; }
      .chart svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      .chart .garis { fill: none; stroke: var(--utama); }
      .chart .titik { fill: var(--aksen); }
      .end { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--latar); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        text-align: center; padding: 0 160px; }
      .end .judul { font-size: 150px; line-height: 0.98; }
      .end .judul b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); font-weight: inherit; }
      .end .wa { margin-top: 70px; padding: 30px 70px; border-radius: 90px; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; }
      .end .nama { margin-top: 40px; font-size: 44px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <div class="glow" id="glow"></div>

      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="alert" id="alert"><i></i>Saldo iklan habis<em>Rp0</em></div>
        <div class="roas-label">ROAS</div>
        <div class="roas turun" id="roas1">1.2x</div>
        <div class="tanya" id="tanya">
          <span class="line"><span>Iklan jalan…</span></span>
          <span class="line"><span>omzet kok <b>diem?</b></span></span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="fact">
        <div class="platforms">
          <h2>Semua platform,<br /><b>1 tim.</b></h2>
          <div class="pf"><b>Media sosial</b><span>Feed & story</span></div>
          <div class="pf"><b>Pencarian</b><span>Kata kunci</span></div>
          <div class="pf"><b>Video pendek</b><span>Live & afiliasi</span></div>
          <div class="pf"><b>Marketplace</b><span>Toko & voucher</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="number">
        <div class="dash">
          <h3>Dasbor real-time</h3>
          <div class="card"><small>ROAS</small><div class="big" id="roas2">1.2x</div></div>
          <div class="pair">
            <div class="card"><small>CPA</small><b id="cpa">Rp0</b></div>
            <div class="card"><small>OMZET</small><b id="omzet">Rp0</b></div>
          </div>
          <div class="card chart">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 800 300" preserveAspectRatio="none">
              <path id="line" class="garis" d="M10 260 L130 240 L250 250 L370 190 L490 170 L610 110 L730 40" stroke-width="10"
                stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="900" stroke-dashoffset="0" />
              <circle id="titik" class="titik" cx="730" cy="40" r="16" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="end" id="end" data-role="cta">
        <div class="judul">AUDIT AKUN IKLAN <b>GRATIS</b></div>
        <div class="wa">Chat Chat sekarang</div>
        <div class="nama">Chat 0812-3456-7890 · Iklanku</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const rp = (n) => "Rp" + Math.round(n).toLocaleString("id-ID");
      const x = (n) => n.toFixed(1) + "x";

      tl.fromTo("#glow", { scale: 0.9 }, { scale: 1.15, duration: 15, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0);

      // Adegan 1 (0–4 detik), hook: peringatan jatuh, ROAS turun merah, pertanyaan naik dari mask.
      const r1 = { v: 1.2 };
      const roas1 = document.getElementById("roas1");
      tl.from("#alert", { y: -60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.6)" }, 0.2)
        .from("#roas1", { scale: 0.7, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "expo.out" }, 0.5)
        .to(r1, { v: 0.8, duration: 1.2, ease: "power2.inOut", onUpdate: () => { roas1.textContent = x(r1.v); } }, 0.8)
        .from("#tanya .line span", { yPercent: 110, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.14 }, 1.6)
        .to("#s1", { xPercent: -100, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 3.8);

      // Adegan 2 (4–7 detik), fact: judul, lalu kartu naik satu per satu ke grid 2×2.
      tl.from("#s2", { xPercent: 100, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 3.8)
        .from(".platforms h2", { y: 60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 4.3)
        .from(".pf", { y: 70, opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.5)", stagger: 0.12 }, 4.6)
        .to("#s2", { xPercent: -100, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 7.0);

      // Adegan 3 (7–11 detik), number: angka dasbor dihitung naik, garis grafik tergambar.
      const r2 = { v: 1.2 }, cpa = { v: 0 }, omz = { v: 0 };
      const roas2 = document.getElementById("roas2"), cpaEl = document.getElementById("cpa"), omzEl = document.getElementById("omzet");
      tl.from("#s3", { xPercent: 100, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 7.0)
        .to(r2, { v: 4.6, duration: 1.6, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { roas2.textContent = x(r2.v); } }, 7.5)
        .to(cpa, { v: 32000, duration: 1.4, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { cpaEl.textContent = rp(cpa.v); } }, 7.7)
        .to(omz, { v: 48900000, duration: 1.6, ease: "power3.out", onUpdate: () => { omzEl.textContent = "Rp" + (omz.v / 1e6).toLocaleString("id-ID", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) + " jt"; } }, 7.7)
        .fromTo("#line", { attr: { "stroke-dashoffset": 900 } }, { attr: { "stroke-dashoffset": 0 }, duration: 1.6, ease: "power2.out" }, 7.8)
        .from("#titik", { scale: 0, transformOrigin: "50% 50%", duration: 0.4, ease: "back.out(2.4)" }, 9.3);

      // Penutup (11–15 detik), cta: panel menyapu turun, ajakan diam lebih dari 2 detik.
      tl.fromTo("#end", { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 100% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 11.0)
        .from("#end > *", { y: 70, opacity: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.14 }, 11.4)
        .to(".end .wa", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.45, yoyo: true, repeat: 3, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 12.3)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
